title: Prove a 2-adic gauge bound for rational P104 decoders
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A rational decoder has pairing-rank mass at least the number of ports in any simultaneously 2-adically integral subset after reciprocal row and diagonal port gauges. Feasibility for a fixed subset is an exact difference-constraints problem. A 56-port subset therefore suffices for the decoder wall in this class, including nonlinear quarter-denominator terms.

## Task and overlap

Scoped #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212` on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. #7852 proves bounds in the narrower linear classes and supplies the integral rank lemma. #7583 gives the pairing-rank price in its row model. This proof applies the rank lemma to arbitrary rational factorizations under a checkable subset condition.

## Validation

`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-2adic-decoder-gauges` and the committed-byte check passed on CPython 3.12.3. Exact controls check quarter-denominator cancellation, protected port feasibility, and mutation rejection. The pinned E8 decoder exposes a limitation of the subset test. Network and word extraction remain open.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 model and the pinned E8 data. Clear1nsight prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

Apply the gauge test to an exact network factorization and prove that the charged word price dominates the restricted decoder mass.
